---
title: "Reproducibility"
---

## Benchmark lifecycle

```text
isolated installed package at a pinned SHA
→ validated specification and semantic checkpoints
→ reviewed compact outputs
→ validated current reference capsule
→ capsule-only Quarto report
```

Working outputs, target stores, logs, and isolated libraries live below ignored
`results/local/`. Current public evidence lives below `results/reference/`:

```text
01_finemapping/current
02_prediction/current
03_parameter_estimation/current
04_convergence/current-selection
04_convergence/current-validation
05_ld_operator/current
06_annotation_models/current-stop
```

Each capsule records design, seeds, controls, fit counts, exact package source
provenance, compact result tables, source inventories, session information, and
checksums. Full fits, sparse-LD stores, Q factors, and targets caches are excluded.
Git history is the archive for earlier benchmark versions.

## Running a study

The shared CLI validates specifications, package provenance, and checkpoint
identity. Validation-only mode resolves the complete design without fitting:

```powershell
Rscript scripts/run_benchmark.R --study 02_prediction --profile benchmark --output-dir results/local/02_prediction --resume true --validate-only true
```

The current refresh was run against a local isolated installation of `sblr`
0.2.0 at SHA `02e8c74baa906e83c4a08d42a9cc6339b4e81072`. Study 05 retains numerical-fit
provenance at its earlier compatible SHA and includes a deterministic compatibility
audit; its manifest does not falsely claim a rerun.

## Report isolation

```bash
quarto render
```

Reports read only tracked current capsules. Rendering never constructs LD,
simulates phenotypes, calls samplers, or reads `results/local`. The complete site
is rendered and audited for broken local links. Study 06's tracked stop capsule
is explicitly development evidence; Study 07 has no authoritative capsule.

Study 01 uses public simulated PLINK data from a pinned qgdata revision. Its
current capsule records file sizes and checksums without copying large genotype
files into the repository.
